title.en: Say the thing you keep not saying
title.hi: Woh baat kahiye jo aap keh nahi paa rahe

body.en: Most fathers are carrying one worry they have decided not to mention. It does not get smaller by month nine. Say it this week, plainly, and let her carry half.
body.hi: Zyadatar pita ek fikr apne andar rakhte hain jise unhone na kehne ka faisla kiya hai. Woh nauve maheene tak chhoti nahi hoti. Is hafte seedhe kahiye, aur aadha use uthane dijiye.
